name: pm-groundwork
description: A PM starter kit for AI tools. Part 1 bootstraps a project workspace with persistent memory, decision logging, and session rituals. Part 2 runs the engagement — documentation only, documentation plus a prototype, or a full delivery plan. Works in Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Claude Cowork; also available to Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI through the pm-groundwork MCP server.
